name: get_context
description: Get recent context events, logs, audits, prompts, transcripts, and summaries for a session or workspace.

body_limit.description: truncate event body in this response to this many runes; default 500, maximum 16384. Set to 0 or pass full_body=true to disable response truncation. Audit payloads truncated at ingestion remain truncated.

continuation.description: opaque continuation returned by this same tool

full_body.description: return the full stored body even when it is long. Equivalent to body_limit=0; does not restore audit payload bytes dropped at ingestion

projection.description: event projection: metadata omits body fields, bounded reads only a limited visible-text body from storage, full returns the full stored body; omitted preserves body_limit/full_body compatibility

continuation.description: opaque cursor for the next page; use only with the same tool and filters

coverage.description: observed candidate and returned counts under the response budget

aggregate_body_budget.description: maximum encoded body and body_blocks bytes per response

aggregate_body_bytes.description: encoded body and body_blocks bytes returned

candidate_count.description: body-free candidates examined for this page

returned_count.description: event metadata records returned in this response

body.description: event body as a plain-text projection; absent for projection=metadata. For transcript JSON envelopes this joins text blocks and excludes thinking blocks — use body_blocks for the canonical structured form. May be truncated to body_limit characters; check body_truncated and body_length

body_blocks.description: structured block form of the body when it is a canonical transcript envelope; populated for list_events only — search and get_context omit it so thinking-block text does not leak through those surfaces; also absent for legacy plain-text bodies, non-envelope JSON bodies, empty envelopes, and rows whose body is truncated

body_ingest_truncated.description: whether ingestion truncated the event body when known

body_length.description: original body length in runes before any truncation; only emitted when body_truncated is true

body_original_bytes.description: original event body byte count when known

body_storage_truncated.description: whether storage policy truncated the event body when known

body_stored_bytes.description: stored event body byte count; available for projection=metadata

body_truncated.description: true when body was truncated to fit body_limit. Re-issue the same call with full_body=true (or a larger body_limit) to disable response truncation; audit payloads truncated at ingestion stay visibly truncated and are not recoverable

body_unavailable_reason.description: reason the raw body is unavailable; currently retention

exit_code.description: command exit code when available in metadata projection

failed.description: whether the linked command audit failed

source_hook.description: hook identifier that produced this event (omitted for non-hook writes)

interval.description: requested and effective half-open interval used by list_events or search

snapshot_at.description: UTC snapshot used for omitted upper bounds

timezone.description: IANA timezone used for date-only bounds

partial.description: whether another page or body-budget reduction remains

name: get_report

page_size.description: internal database page size; default 5000, maximum 100000, and does not cap aggregate results

timezone.description: IANA timezone for date-only bounds (default: UTC); Local is rejected

to.description: exclusive RFC3339 instant or inclusive calendar date

coverage.description: complete only when all aggregate sources are complete

result_cap.description: caller-requested per-source row cap; omitted means unlimited

coverage.description: complete when the full filter was scanned; partial when result_cap truncated the source

response_truncated.description: whether rows beyond result_cap were excluded

coverage.description: complete when the full filter was scanned; partial when result_cap truncated the source

coverage.description: complete when the full filter was scanned; partial when result_cap truncated the source

result_cap.description: caller-requested per-source row cap; omitted means unlimited

name: manage_memory
description: Dispatch durable memory writes by action; reject and expire are destructive actions.

action.description: required,action enum: propose, remember, accept, reject, expire, supersede, set_validity, import_instructions

kind.description: reference kind enum (evidence_refs: event, session, url, file, issue, pr; artifact_refs: url, file, issue, pr)

value.description: reference value (event/session id, URL, file path, issue or pr number)

clear_valid_to.description: remove the existing valid_to; incompatible with valid_to

kind.description: reference kind enum (evidence_refs: event, session, url, file, issue, pr; artifact_refs: url, file, issue, pr)

value.description: reference value (event/session id, URL, file path, issue or pr number)

expires_at.description: expiry timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC3339, defaults to now)

ids.description: single memory id or array of memory ids for accept/reject batch actions

markdown.description: raw markdown content to parse when path is not provided

memory_id.description: durable memory identifier for single-id actions

path.description: absolute path to the instruction file

target_id.description: accepted durable memory identifier to supersede

valid_from.description: start of validity window (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC3339)

valid_to.description: end of validity window (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC3339)

name: manage_session
description: Dispatch session lifecycle writes by action: start or end. action=end is destructive (closes the session).

action.description: required,action enum: start, end, active, latest, handoff, lineage, tree

as_of.description: evaluate durable memory validity at this timestamp

depth.description: maximum descendant depth for action=tree (0 returns only the root)

include_candidates.description: include candidate durable memories in a separate needs-review section for action=handoff

infer_parent_session.description: infer parent from the active session when parent_session_id is omitted (default: true for MCP starts)

parent_session_id.description: parent session identifier for sub-agent sessions

preset.description: built-in retrieval preset applied to durable memories

stale_after_seconds.description: mark active sessions older than this many seconds as stale

source_hook.description: hook identifier that produced this event (omitted for non-hook writes)

name: query_memory
description: Dispatch durable memory reads by action: retrieve, export, pack, or scan_hygiene.

action.description: required,action enum: retrieve, export, pack, scan_hygiene

as_of.description: evaluate content validity at this timestamp

cursor.description: process-authenticated continuation returned by a partial hygiene scan; start a new scan if the server restarted

include_candidates.description: include candidate memories in a separate needs-review section for action=pack

include_expired.description: include memories whose valid_to is in the past

include_global.description: include global memories alongside a workspace export (default true)

limit.description: maximum number of memories to return (default: 20)

max_comparisons.description: maximum duplicate or similarity comparisons per hygiene invocation

max_duration_ms.description: maximum wall-clock duration for one hygiene invocation in milliseconds

max_result_bytes.description: maximum serialized suggestion bytes returned by one hygiene invocation

max_scan_bytes.description: maximum raw source bytes charged to one hygiene invocation

max_scan_rows.description: maximum source rows charged to one hygiene invocation

memory_id.description: durable memory identifier to fetch directly

no_global.description: export only the explicit workspace scope; do not include global memories

offset.description: number of memories to skip before returning results (default: 0)

preset.description: built-in retrieval preset: resume | review | incident

similarity.description: word-Jaccard threshold for hygiene supersede suggestions (0 uses the default 0.6)

source.description: memory source filters: manual, extracted, extracted-hidden, imported

name: record_event
description: Record a log or command audit event by type, returning one uniform event shape.

failure_reason.description: structured outcome: none, exit_code, signal, timeout, hook_denied, host_error, or unknown

type.description: required,event write type: log or audit

body_blocks.description: structured block form of transcript body

failed.description: whether structured outcome evidence indicates failure

input_original_bytes.description: original input byte count when input_truncated is true and known

output_original_bytes.description: original output byte count when output_truncated is true and known

source_hook.description: hook identifier that produced this event

type.description: event write type: log or audit
